caseNameFull: BOEING CO. v. HAMM, COMMISSIONER OF REVENUE OF ALABAMA
attorneys: John Bingham for appellant., MacDonald Gallion, Attorney General of Alabama, and Willard W. Livingston and William H. Burton, Assistant Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
